visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black-rimmed glasses and large over-ear headphones is seated on a soft grey sofa, holding a black studio microphone. He is wearing a light beige long-sleeved sweatshirt. Behind him, a cream-colored curtain covers the background. He looks slightly to the side while speaking, his facial expressions shifting as he poses a question. (2) The scene cuts between a woman in a grey sweatshirt with black headphones, sitting in front of wooden bookshelves filled with books, and a man with long dark hair tied back, wearing a beige sweatshirt with a cartoon graphic that says 'I WILL BE LEMONATE!'. The woman gestures emphatically with her hands and touches her neck while talking. The long-haired man laughs, squinting his eyes and tilting his head back. (3) The first man returns to the screen, now holding a smartphone in his left hand while gesturing with his right. He mimes the action of holding a glass for a toast, moving his hands and body with exaggerated comedic energy. The indoor lighting is warm and soft throughout the sequence.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: （網友留言）好奇交往. [Subtitle]: 要是發現對方牙齒卡菜渣會提醒嗎？. (2) [Subtitle]: 要是偶爾一起晚餐約會 在外面一起吃個小吃 聊聊天的溫馨場景. (3) [Subtitle]: 真的可以在相談甚歡的時候說 欸你牙齒卡了鴨血之類的嗎？. (4) [Subtitle]: 場面會冷掉吧 好奇阿端大師會如何化解這些棘手的問題呢？. (5) [Subtitle]: 哦我會直接說啊 哦我一定會直接講！. (6) [Subtitle]: 好～過～分～ 直接說 蛤你不會講嗎？. (7) [Subtitle]: 欸如果我發現我之後自己發現 然後我發現你都沒有告訴我. (8) [Subtitle]: 我會超不爽欸！. (9) [Subtitle]: 我跟你講 如果我們現在一起吃飯 吃了兩個小時 喔法式晚餐. (10) [Subtitle]: 然後他最後才跟我說 陳脆安去上廁所 發現說她的那個門牙 被一個海帶擋住 整個門牙黑的. (11) [Subtitle]: 她出來絕對跟我發火說 坐在我對面三個小時 你都沒有發現我牙齒渣 你是不會講一下是不是 你是不是覺得 對 你是不是看到我被所有人就是暗自嘲笑你覺得很爽. (12) [Subtitle]: 被吸進去了 不行啊 你為她好真的要講啊. (13) [Subtitle]: 但是你可以就是小小聲的 不用當著大家的面吧？. (14) [Subtitle]: 當大家的面也沒關係 (香檳) 叮叮叮 我要宣佈一件事. (15) [Subtitle]: 對 我要舉杯 我要宣佈一件事. (16) [Subtitle]: 那個陳脆安的牙齒上 有個海帶 大家快看 不要這樣就好了.
